selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods; no hidden interpolation and no observation enters before its event year.
limitations: All numbers are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
Structural events establish context but cannot identify all six numeric dimensions; cross-country calibration is outstanding.
Early priors are registered separately from independent federation observations.
No rankings, titles, athlete results or predecessor-wide population/player totals are used.
2021 grant eligibility is not funding receipt and makes no numerical change.
2026 is partial through the bundle cutoff, not a forecast.
